pain_points.quote: Anchor the foundations, develop strengths, integrate durably.
pain_points.desc_1: In many sports journeys, technique is worked on, but what makes a child persevere in the long run is left out:
pain_points.desc_bold_1: confidence, emotion management, concentration, and the ability to bounce back after a mistake.
pain_points.desc_2: When those foundations aren’t built, a child can progress for a while, then tense up, hold back or lose the joy of it. THRIVE helps them build those foundations:
pain_points.desc_bold_2: skills they keep, in sport and beyond.
pain_points.list_1: They learn to better manage pressure and mistakes, in training as well as in matches.
pain_points.list_2: They develop mental reflexes useful at school, in sports, and during daily moments of tension.
pain_points.list_3: They gain stability, autonomy, and confidence, with skills that last beyond the season.
pain_points.list_4: They build concrete tools that also help them in their daily life, not just on the field.
pain_points.conclusion: THRIVE isn’t trying to manufacture a champion. We help your child lay solid foundations, so they move forward with more confidence, more calm and more enjoyment, now and later on.

comparison.heading: Why choose THRIVE?
comparison.sub_heading_1: Because between the sports club and the clinician’s office, something was missing: an approach that is positive, structured, personalised and measurable.
comparison.desc_1_1: At THRIVE, your child doesn’t just get activity time.
comparison.desc_1_2: A coach follows them closely, their progress is measured, and they leave with concrete tools for their confidence, their emotions and their relationships.
comparison.subtitle: What really changes
comparison.row1_cl: One coach for 15 to 20 young people
comparison.row1_th: Two adults for 4 to 6 young people, or one coach one-on-one
comparison.row2_th: Sports workshops chosen for a life skill, structured and personalised
comparison.row3_th: Build confidence, emotional regulation and connection with others
comparison.row4_th: Measured at the start, the midpoint and the end, with a report in their name
comparison.row5_th: See what evolves, why it matters, and how the child progresses
comparison.diff_p1: Most conventional options sell a session, a presence or a correction. THRIVE reduces uncertainty and makes progress visible.
comparison.diff_p2: You’re not buying a block of time: you’re giving your child a clear, reassuring and measured journey.
comparison.obtain_l1: A THRIVE coach who knows your child.
comparison.obtain_l3: A positive method, grounded in research.
comparison.obtain_l4: Concrete tools, useful in sport and in life.
comparison.obtain_l5: Two calls with the coach, at the midpoint and at the end.
comparison.obtain_l6: A report in their name, to see what has changed.
comparison.who_p1: THRIVE is for families who want a serious, human and credible way to help their child gain confidence, without unnecessary pressure.
comparison.who_p2: It is also a considered response for parents who want proofs, not just promises.
comparison.closing: THRIVE helps your child build their tools in a positive, personalised and measured setting, so they progress with confidence, not by chance.

process.title: Our 3-Step Method
process.subtitle: A 13-session journey, from the starting point to independence.
process.step1_d: Build trust, measure the starting point and lay the foundations. Your child learns about themselves: their strengths, and what they want to achieve.
process.step2_d: Practise the 6 skills, one at a time. Your child tries, fails, adjusts and progresses in a setting where mistakes are safe.
process.step3_d: Consolidate, measure how far they’ve come and prepare for independence. Your child uses their tools on their own, on the field and in life.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: My child is new to sport — is this for them?
faq.a1: Yes. The workshops are new to everyone and each child picks their own level: nobody is already “the best”. We’re not teaching them a sport — we use sport to practise confidence, emotions and connecting with others.
faq.q2: Where do the sessions take place?
faq.a2: At Centre Saint-Denis, in Plateau-Mont-Royal, at a fixed weekly slot. THRIVE Home, for its part, happens at your place.
faq.q3: Do parents need to be present?
faq.a3: No. To protect their space, your child experiences the sessions without you. You receive their report in the app, and we call you at the midpoint and at the end to talk it through.
faq.a4: THRIVE is not a health service: it is generally not reimbursed by group insurance. Some employer wellness accounts do cover physical and sports activities — check with your plan.

method.intro_desc: Developed by Dr. Martin Seligman, the father of positive psychology, this model is our compass. We don't guess how to motivate your child; we apply a validated science.

perma.p_d: Pleasure releases dopamine, accelerating motor learning. A happy child learns 3x faster than an anxious child.
perma.e_d: We structure challenges to reach the state of "Flow", where concentration is total and time disappears.
perma.r_d: The coach-athlete bond is the foundation of emotional security. Knowing they are unconditionally supported frees the child from the fear of making mistakes.
perma.m_d: Every exercise has a "why". We connect effort to the child's values (mutual aid, courage) to give meaning to fatigue.
perma.a_d: Confidence is not given; it is built through victories. We create "micro-successes" in every session to build self-efficacy.

science.title: The Measurable Impact of Happiness
science.stat1_d: Studies show that positive brains are 31% more productive and accurate than negative or stressed brains.
science.stat2_d: Positive emotions broaden the attentional field, allowing one to see more play solutions (Broaden-and-Build Theory).
science.stat3_d: The caring approach reduces cortisol (stress hormone), promoting faster physical and mental recovery.

scorecard.title: The THRIVE Scorecard
scorecard.subtitle: The Engineering of Transformation: Transforming the intangible into a measurable asset.
scorecard.val_text1: All these measurements are made using
scorecard.val_text2: validated by international psychology committees. These are real diagnostic tools, not just observations.
scorecard.s1_desc: A physiological analysis at each session to adapt the intensity. We don't force learning on a tired nervous system.
scorecard.s1_b1_d: Measures "Readiness". A low HRV signals invisible fatigue; we adapt the session to protect self-esteem.
scorecard.s1_b2_d: Evaluation of sleep, mood, and global stress (school, family, sports). The child is taken into account as a whole.
scorecard.s1_b3_d: Detects mental blocks: if perceived effort is 9/10 for a simple exercise, we intervene immediately.
scorecard.s2_desc: Tangible proof of the change in sports personality. We measure the transition from "avoidance" to "proactivity".
scorecard.s2_b1_d: Measures the 4Cs: Confidence, Control, Challenge, Commitment. We bring the child out of the shadows.
scorecard.s2_b2_d: The measurement of "Flourishing". Scientific validation that the child is happy, engaged, and accomplished.
scorecard.s2_b3_d: Changes the narrative: we no longer talk about what needs fixing, but about their powerful "signature strengths".
scorecard.s3_desc: Proving that internal values translate into external actions on the ice.
scorecard.s3_b1_d: Proves that the child now plays for themselves (intrinsic) and not out of fear of disappointing.
scorecard.s3_b2_d: Surgical measurement of confidence in a technical gesture. Confidence is no longer blurry; it becomes a certainty.
scorecard.s3_b3_d: The "Gold Standard". Observation of concrete behaviors (e.g., encouraging a teammate after a mistake).

dashboard.title: The Elite Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Strategic Visualization to maximize value. A report worthy of a high-end consultant, not just an instructor.
dashboard.b1_desc: Spider web chart overlaying Session 1 (Baseline) and Session 6.
dashboard.b2_li1: Encouraged their goalie after a conceded goal (Leadership)
dashboard.b2_li2: Requested an extra rep on their own initiative (Engagement)
dashboard.b2_li3: Kept their calm after two consecutive failures (Emotional Control)
dashboard.b3_desc: Line graph showing the drop in cortisol and HRV regulation over the weeks. Proof of stress management.
dashboard.b4_desc: Visual badge of the 5 dominant strengths.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Direct, jargon-free answers to help you choose with confidence.
faq.q1_a: They dare on their own but hold back in front of others, or stay on the sidelines in a group: THRIVE Group. They give up as soon as it gets hard and need a one-on-one setting: THRIVE One-on-One. What you want most is a real moment with them every day, despite the lack of time: THRIVE Home. Not sure? The free 15-minute call is exactly for that.
faq.q2_q: Does my child need a problem or a diagnosis?
faq.q2_a: No. THRIVE addresses everyday situations: a child who gives up quickly, hangs back, or struggles to approach others. If your child is in significant distress or has a diagnosis that requires care, we'll refer you to a professional.
faq.q3_a: For the Group and One-on-One: nothing at sign-up, then two equal instalments, at the start of the 1st and the 7th session ($300 + $300 for the Group, $750 + $750 for One-on-One). For THRIVE Home: one month free, then $32.50 a month or $299 a year, with no commitment; on iPhone and Android, the final price is the one shown by the App Store or Google Play.
faq.q4_q: What if the program isn't right for my child?
faq.q4_a: If you’re not convinced after the 2nd session, you stop and your 1st instalment is refunded in full. After that, you can stop at any time: you only pay for the sessions you received.
faq.q5_a: No. THRIVE is a coaching and skills-development program. It does not replace psychological care. If your child is in significant distress or has received a diagnosis, we'll refer you to a professional.
faq.q6_a: Because each program includes far more than sessions: a structured 13-week journey, a challenge to take on outside the session every week, measurement at the start, the midpoint and the end, two calls with the coach, and THRIVE Home throughout the program. Clubs and private lessons work on technique; THRIVE works on what they don’t have time for: daring to try, and reaching out to others.
faq.q7_a: At Centre Saint-Denis, in Plateau-Mont-Royal, at a fixed weekly slot. Groups start on set dates; One-on-One starts 1 to 2 weeks after the call. THRIVE Home happens at your place.
